MRFT.description: Moment Redistribution Factor (MRFT). Assigned per BEAM-type element to define the moment reduction (redistribution) factor used in RC design; can only be assigned to BEAM members.

FACTOR.description: Moment Reduction Factor applied in moment redistribution. For the Eurocode2:04 concrete code a lower bound of 0.7 is enforced (values below 0.7 are clamped to 0.7).
